findings.location: Goal; Assumptions and constraints; Increment C
findings.problem: The plan attributes its authorization to “option 1a” of `2026-10-25-approver-coverage-for-the-module-commands`, but that plan does not exist. The accepted decision instead records Question 1 option 2 (owner adds global `ask` entries) and Question 2 option 1 (not delegated). This makes the governing owner choice ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Replace the nonexistent reference and undefined “option 1a” label with the accepted decision’s exact question/option identifiers, and state that the patch remains undelegated.

findings.location: Increment A and Increment C; docs/specs/global-config-inventory.md, M1
findings.problem: The inventory currently names `2026-10-25-approver-program-and-the-module-spellings` as M1 stage 1’s carrying plan. This new plan intends to become the carrying plan, but no step explicitly changes that reference; its completion would leave the spec pointing at the wrong plan.
findings.suggestion: Add an explicit spec-edit step that replaces M1’s carrying-plan reference with this plan when appropriate, while retaining the prior plan only as the source of the measured baseline and decision.

summary: The plan’s technical scope is largely aligned with M1, but its governing decision reference and resulting carrying-plan reference need correction.
